name: Massive Crushing Door (CR 10)
body:
Massive Crushing Door
CR 10

XP –

Source: Pathfinder #5

Type mechanical; Perception DC 28; Disable Device DC 24

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset automatic

Effect crush (12d10 bludgeoning, DC 24 Reflex save to avoid); multiple targets (all creatures in four adjacent 5-ft. squares).
